thread:
felix: Heads-up: flying into FRA at 00:40, then an overnight train to Zurich at 06:30. Whats the best low-effort way to charge, stash luggage, and grab a nap without paying for a hotel?
maria: If it's Terminal 1 -> long-distance trains are at the Fernbahnhof, needs a shuttle from T1 sometimes. Check if you can transfer within the same terminal.
jordan: Left-luggage lockers at Hauptbahnhof are open 24/7, but getting from FRA airport to the central station takes ~15-20min by S-Bahn.
zara: Pro-tip: consolidate essentials into a daypack, gate-check the big bag if the connection is tight. Keep passport and ticket on you.
transitbot: S-Bahn S8 runs 24/7? Note: Night schedule changes on weekends. See DB night timetable: https://www.bahn.com/en
felix: Is there anywhere in the airport quiet enough to nap for 2-3 hours? Don't want to be woken up by cleaning crew at 4am.
maria: In T1, the quiet corners are usually in the non-Schengen end near gates K. Lean against a wall and set an alarm. Also bring an eye mask.
jordan: Noise-cancelling earbuds + earplugs is overkill but works. Also bring a short USB-C cable and a small powerbank (20k mAh ok).
zara: If you can spare cash, the Hilton Frankfurt Airport is connected to the terminal walkway, hourly rooms sometimes cheaper than a full night.
felix: Any quick food recs that won't ruin a nap? Want something light and not smelly on the train.
maria: Greek yogurt, banana, and a small wrap. Avoid strong curry or deep-fried stuff.
jordan: Hot water is your friend for instant noodles but might make you too awake. Electrolyte sachets + water for the train.
felix: Luggage lockers at the airport vs Hauptbahnhof? Which is safer/cheaper?
zara: Airport lockers are pricier and limited. Hauptbahnhof has more options and staff presence. If timing allows, go central.
transitbot: Note: Locker sizes vary. Large lockers might be out of service. Cashless payments vary by station.
felix: Awesome, packing an eye mask, scarf, powerbank and snacks. Appreciate the tips. Will ping when I land if anyone has last-minute recs.
maria: Safe travels! If you need a quick check on train times DM me and I'll look them up.
jordan: Bring a reusable water bottle to refill after security. Also keep a photocopy/photo of passport in your phone.
zara: And stickers for the team, please. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
